paragraphs.source_en: While it may not initially appear so, this point in the program is very encouraging. So far your financial life has had very little direction or consciousness. Financially speaking, you have been like someone driving around without any destination—burning gas, spinning your wheels, and getting nowhere. You may have many happy memories and other intangibles, but only a few real souvenirs that could be converted into cash. With the power and clear direction that taking the reins of your financial affairs will give you, you will be far more effective in the world.

Meanwhile, his money was earning interest, his life became simpler, and someone who really needed those items was getting use out of them.

paragraphs.source_en: And remember: No shame, no blame.
